newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Citatah estimates 1996 net 24.8 bln rph.
newsitem.headline: Citatah estimates 1996 net 24.8 bln rph.

text.p: Indonesian marble producer PT Citatah Industry Marmer on Thursday estimated its 1996 net profit at 24.8 billion rupiah against 5.67 billion in 1995.
It also revised up its 1997 net profit forecast to 33.8 billion rupiah from 32.3 billion.
"We estimate our net profit last year at $24.8 billion rupiah. We have also revised up our net profit forecast for 1997 to 33.8 billion rupiah," president director Taufik Johannes told Reuters.
Johannes said the higher forecast was partly due to unexpectedly higher sales after the opening of its new marble quarry at Kerawang in West Java. He declined to give further details.
He said sales in 1996 were estimated at 96.8 billion rupiah.
PT Citatah, which was listed on the Jakarta Stock Exchange in July last year, was trading at 2,675 rupiah at the mid-session on Thursday.
